purpose: Preparation for ONE possible later colour call that produces only the hidden technical skin underlay of the D-148 R3 head. Nothing here authorises a call.

layerContract.underlay: BALD, BLANK FACE — the hidden technical skin underlay; featureless
modelMayProduce: warm tan skin matched to Northstar
an even, fully covering head surface

pipelineResponsibility.model: RGB of the head surface only, inside the API mask's editable area
deterministic: K4 outer contour applied AFTER the model
TRANSITION and PROTECT₂ byte-identical to H1
rejection on missing coverage, uncovered transition, residue/ghost pixels or any failed gate

rule.statistic: per-channel median of the skin-class pixels in both patches

u1.rule: D-148 head geometry (rows ≤ 424) filled with the sampled skin colour, alpha 255; everything else alpha 0

u2.rule: factor = 1 − 0.06 · max(0, 1 − (d − 1) / 14), d = Euclidean distance to the nearest pixel outside the head geometry, rows > 424 counted as inside so the neck continues unshaded (window 16); rgb = round(skin · factor)

rule.semantics: alpha 0 = EDITABLE, alpha 255 = PROTECTED, RGB 0,0,0 everywhere (Images edit endpoint; same as build-r3-api-mask.mjs)
rule.finalModelRgbRegion: FINAL_MODEL_RGB_REGION = GEOM (the D-148 head, rows ≤ 424) — the only pixels whose final RGB comes from the model
rule.apiContextMargin: API_CONTEXT_MARGIN = { y ≤ 424 : p ∉ GEOM ∧ Chebyshev distance to GEOM ≤ 2 } — request-time working room only, discarded entirely by the post-processing
rule.p2Edit2: P2 EDIT₂ (D-148) is NOT changed and is NOT the API mask
rule.previous: v1 of this mask (sha 246546f2…) was dilate8²(GEOM) ∩ (EDIT₂ \ TRANSITION); it left 139 of 734 head-edge px without a 2-px margin
rule.editable: dilate8^2(GEOM) ∩ CORE₂ where CORE₂ = EDIT₂ \ TRANSITION

edgeMargin.exceptionReason: four jaw-corner px (two mirror pairs): the 2nd outward neighbour is in row 425, which API_CONTEXT_MARGIN never enters; each keeps a 1-px margin

apiContextMargin.name: API_CONTEXT_MARGIN
apiContextMargin.rule: API_CONTEXT_MARGIN = { y ≤ 424 : p ∉ GEOM ∧ Chebyshev distance to GEOM ≤ 2 } — request-time working room only, discarded entirely by the post-processing
apiContextMargin.fate: request-time working room only — the post-processing never copies one of these pixels into the candidate

finalModelRgbRegion.name: FINAL_MODEL_RGB_REGION
finalModelRgbRegion.rule: FINAL_MODEL_RGB_REGION = GEOM (the D-148 head, rows ≤ 424) — the only pixels whose final RGB comes from the model

S2.neckTargetRule: per-channel median of H1 skin-class pixels (CIELAB h 30–90°, L* ≥ 72) inside TRANSITION, rows 425–433
S2.formula: out = floor((w·neck + (9 − w)·rgb + 4) / 9), w = y − 416, head pixels of rows 417–424 only, before K4

S1.derivation: p95 of CIEDE2000(Northstar skin-class pixel, Northstar skin median) over x 380–644, y 300–420

toneContinuity.recommendation: S2 (local chin/neck continuity) + S1 (whole-head palette) — distinct purposes

regions.rule: ear-left x<366 · ear-right x>657 · crown y≤259 · lower-head y≥381 · side-left 366≤x≤446 · side-right 577≤x≤657 · face-plane otherwise — geometric coverage regions, not facial features

decision: NONE — a later owner decision must assign a call-id, a claim identity and a mechanical approval value

prohibitions.noImageRequest: No image or API call is authorised. The preparation adapter has no send path.
prohibitions.noClaim: No claim exists or may be created by these tools.
prohibitions.noRuntime: Nothing is wired into runtime; R3 stays default OFF; no R2 asset is touched.
